principles: Linear precedence preference (Surface scope takes default priority)
Universal quantifiers (every, all) tend to outscope existential quantifiers (a, some)
Logical operators (negation, modals) interact with quantifiers creating de dicto vs de re readings

reading_1_surface.formula: forall x [Student(x) -> exists y [Book(y) and Read(x, y)]]
reading_1_surface.meaning: Different students may have read different books (Default)

reading_2_inverse.formula: exists y [Book(y) and forall x [Student(x) -> Read(x, y)]]
reading_2_inverse.meaning: There is one particular book that all students read

negation_quantifier_scope.sentence: All that glitters is not gold.
negation_quantifier_scope.reading_surface: forall x [Glitters(x) -> not Gold(x)] (Nothing that glitters is gold)
negation_quantifier_scope.reading_intended: not forall x [Glitters(x) -> Gold(x)] (Not everything that glitters is gold)
